nodes.description: Public mint price in wei, default 0.075 ether; read in mint and writable via setCost.
Maximum number of tokens that can ever be minted (3333), enforced in mint.
Timestamp initialised as block.timestamp + 45 days, making the variable time dependent.
Boolean kill switch that blocks minting when true; toggled by onlyOwner pause().
Flag that when false makes tokenURI return notRevealedUri; set by onlyOwner reveal().
Base metadata URI returned by _baseURI; settable by onlyOwner setBaseURI().
Metadata file extension ('.json') appended in tokenURI; set by setBaseExtension().
Placeholder URI returned by tokenURI while the collection is unrevealed.
Hardcoded payable address that receives 80% of every mint payment.
Public payable mint function: enforces paused/maxSupply/owner/funds checks, mints token, and forwards ETH to commissions and a gift address.
View pseudo-random helper using keccak256 over block.timestamp, msg.sender and caller supplied salt/mod.
onlyOwner function that transfers the whole contract balance to msg.sender via a low level call.
Returns unrevealed URI or concatenated baseURI + tokenId + baseExtension metadata.
onlyOwner function that flips revealed to true.
onlyOwner setter for the mint cost.
View helper that enumerates all token ids owned by an address.
Internal override returning the stored baseURI string.
Constructor initialising ERC721 name/symbol and base/notRevealed URIs.
Caller controlled address used as mint recipient, gift recipient and withdraw destination.
Miner influenced timestamp used as random seed and to initialise headStart.
Low level payable call forwarding giftValue to giftAddress inside mint, external code executes before state is final.
Low level payable call sending 80% of msg.value to the commissions address inside mint.
Low level payable call transferring the full contract balance to msg.sender inside withdraw.
Weak randomness derived from block.timestamp and msg.sender, predictable/manipulable by miners and callers.
Address parameter of walletOfOwner whose token ids are enumerated.
Modulus parameter of randomNum bounding the generated number.
Seed parameter of randomNum mixed into the keccak256 hash.
Salt parameter of randomNum further mixed into the hash.
Token id parameter of tokenURI used for existence check and string concatenation.
New cost value parameter of setCost written into the cost state variable.
Local variable in mint holding totalSupply() and driving all supply based checks and token id.
Local payable address in mint that receives the random gift; starts as msg.sender and may be reassigned to a random owner.
Local variable in mint holding 50% of balance on final mint or 10% of msg.value otherwise.
Local boolean in mint capturing the result of the external ETH transfers.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the mint recipient and initial gift address.
block.timestamp is hashed inside randomNum as a randomness seed (timestamp dependency / weak randomness).
block.timestamp is passed from mint as the _seed argument to randomNum.
headStart state variable is initialised from block.timestamp + 45 days.
msg.sender is included in the keccak256 randomness computation.
mint calls randomNum to pick the gift recipient.
randomNum produces predictable pseudo-randomness used by mint.
giftAddress is the target of the low level value transfer.
giftValue is the amount forwarded in the low level call to giftAddress.
commissions address is the target of the low level value transfer.
msg.sender is the recipient of the full balance transfer in withdraw.
mint performs an external ETH transfer before completing, enabling reentrancy.
mint performs an external ETH transfer to commissions.
withdraw performs an external ETH transfer to the caller.
The gift recipient contract can re-enter mint while the transfer is in flight.
The withdraw recipient can re-enter withdraw before the balance is drained.
mint reads the paused flag to block minting.
mint reads maxSupply to bound total issuance.
mint reads cost to validate msg.value.
Local supply drives the supply based branches and the new token id in mint.
Local success validates the external transfers inside mint.
reveal writes true into the revealed flag.
setCost writes the new value into cost.
_baseURI returns the baseURI state variable.
tokenURI calls _baseURI to build the metadata URI.
tokenURI reads revealed to decide which URI to return.
tokenURI appends baseExtension to the token URI.
tokenURI returns notRevealedUri while unrevealed.
walletOfOwner uses the _owner parameter for balance and enumeration.
randomNum uses _mod as the modulo bound.
randomNum mixes the _seed parameter into the hash.
randomNum mixes the _salt parameter into the hash.
tokenURI uses tokenId for the existence check and URI concatenation.
setCost writes the _newCost parameter into cost.

normalization_plan.reason: The _owner parameter exists only to feed walletOfOwner's enumeration and can be folded into that function node.
The _mod parameter is only consumed by randomNum's modulo operation and normalises into that function.
The _seed parameter is only consumed by randomNum's keccak256 input and normalises into that function.
The _salt parameter is only consumed by randomNum's keccak256 input and normalises into that function.
The tokenId parameter is used exclusively inside tokenURI and merges into that function node.
The _newCost parameter is written straight into cost by setCost and merges into that setter.
The supply local variable is derived from totalSupply() and drives every branch of mint, so it normalises into mint.
The giftAddress local is the direct target of the unsafe low level call and merges into that unsafe operation.
The giftValue local is the direct value forwarded in the unsafe low level call and merges into that unsafe operation.
The success local merely captures the external call result checked within mint and normalises into mint.
